srgb_to_linear — GFX2D colorspace op

• Data kinds: rgb → rgb

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.srgb_to_linear(img) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import gfx2d; gfx2d.srgb_to_linear(img), registry से लेना हो तो opsgfx2d.get("srgb_to_linear"))

उपयोग

sRGB-encoded मान से linear light (IEC 61966-2-1)।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

An alpha channel, if present, is not transformed — coverage is already linear. Accepts (H, W), (H, W, 1|3|4).

Use this before anything that adds or scales light (radial_light, light_mask, normal_map_shade, bloom) if the input came out of an image file. Skipping it does not raise: it makes highlights bloom too early and shadows too dark, by the amount quoted in the module docstring.
